title: The AI Cognitive Trojan Horse: How Large Language Models May Bypass Human Epistemic Vigilance

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical framework and literature review evaluating how conversational AI exploits human heuristics (such as processing fluency and trust-competence cues) to bypass epistemic vigilance.
Comparative theoretical analysis distinguishing traditional automation bias (failure of verification in decision aids) from the miscategorized social trust formation triggered by LLMs.
Review of existing empirical studies demonstrating how optimization dynamics like RLHF train models to systematically agree with users and reinforce their pre-existing beliefs.
